note: Wooded campground with cabins beside Goodman Township Park and its Lake Hilbert beach, near Fence. ATVs can ride from the sites onto the Marinette County trail system. Mostly seasonal: about 33 of its roughly 105 sites are sold by the night. --Claude
summary: Operator site (home, rates, amenities, about, map), Park With Us engine (June 2027), Google and imagery read. Fees $38-45 confirmed (manual) with 5.5% tax; booking -> operator/Park With Us; 30A + water; max rig 50; facilities written. About 33 of ~105 sites nightly (~30%). Not waterfront kept. OHV flag (ride from your site).
flags: PRICE (private): passes. $45 a night summer (Memorial weekend-September; Park With Us shows $45.00/night for 2027-06-15), $38 off-season, before 5.5% tax. Not a Good Sam Park; no gateway within 40 km. Google 4.6 (140); RV Life 4* $$. Presence passes (working site, phone, engine).

LONG-STAY: the map numbers about 72 sites with an 's' suffix (32s-33s, 35s-106s; no legend, read as seasonal) and leaves 1-31 and 34 plain; Park With Us offered 30 sites for a June 2027 Tuesday (1-31 minus 10, 14, 29, plus 34 and 79) and lists a 'Seasonal' unit type; the home page says 'Contact us for seasonal camping prices'. Nightly share about 33 of ~105 (~30%). Passes the five tests on what was read (posted nightly rate, online nightly engine, no wording discouraging nightly guests, 10%+ nightly, no lots sold). Note now says it is mostly seasonal.

OHV (reviewer decides): the operator markets 'Our campground is ideal for ATV riders. You can ride directly from your site. The campground is located on Marinette County Trail' and 'Direct access to ATV trail system'; the map draws the ATV trail along the campground's west edge. It also sells itself as a family campground next to a township beach and lake (playground, arcade, beach), so it reads as a general campground with an OHV side rather than a staging camp, but the brief treats private parks that market ATV trails starting at the campground as out.
WATERFRONT: not waterfront kept. Imagery: the sites are under continuous forest east of Town Park Dr; Lake Hilbert and its beach are 250-300 m west, beyond the township park's open fields.
PIN 45.7069,-88.3998 is at the lodge by the west sites: fine.

WEBSITE https://lakehilbertcampground.com/ and PHONE 715-336-3013 confirmed. Season not stated (rates run all year with an off-season rate October to Memorial weekend; the Lodge opens peak season only). Ownership changed May 2026 (about page). Inclusion evidence current.
